question: Should my client go with this lender?
reply:
That's not something I can call — which lender or loan is right for a client is the broker's call to make, and that's your judgement, not mine.

What the page does show (Example Lender, read 13 Oct 2026, 12:00 pm Perth time): for the Basic Home Loan, variable, owner occupier P&I:

- LVR 60% or less: 6.04% p.a., comparison 6.07% p.a., $0 monthly fee
- LVR 60.01–80%: 6.14% p.a., comparison 6.17% p.a., $0 monthly fee
- LVR 80.01–90%: 6.44% p.a., comparison 6.47% p.a., monthly fee not shown (blank)
- LVR 90.01–95%: 6.84% p.a., comparison rate not shown (blank), $10 monthly fee

Fixed, owner occupier: 1 year 5.89% (comparison 6.52%), 2 years 5.79% (comparison 6.44%), 3+ years 5.99% (comparison 6.49%), with 4 and 5 year terms priced at the 3 year rate plus 0.20%.

Fixed, investor: 1 year 6.09% (comparison 6.81%), 2 years 5.99% (comparison 6.72%), 3+ years 6.19% (comparison 6.77%), same +0.20% rule for 4 and 5 year terms.

Note: the comparison rate is based on a $150,000 loan over 25 years and the page warns it may not include all fees and charges, so it's indicative only. If you want the client's actual LVR or loan amount checked against this, happy to look it up against what's shown.
